rationale: Align the snapshot child discriminator with the correction just recorded: the equal-index variant is no longer a protection to check but an unexecuted variant to sample, since the StopSign adjustment maps such a request to the decided log without the StopSign which still exceeds the observed content. The discriminator now names three concrete executions: a request exactly equal to the drifted decided index, a follower called directly, and the peers that receive the forwarded compaction, each observed through their own snapshots and reads.

investigations.discriminator: Three executions would settle the remaining variants: a snapshot request exactly equal to the drifted decided index (the adjustment lowers the bound by one but, in the observed state, 8 still exceeds content of six, so it is expected to lose the entries as well), a follower called directly with its own drifted decided index, and the peers that receive the forwarded compaction; each observed through that node own snapshot and its reads of the compacted region.
